sanskrit: pṛcchati sma mahādevī brūhi jñānaṃ maheśvara brahmajñānaṃ kathaṃ deva sṛṣṭisaṃhāravarjitam avyaktaṃ brahmaṇo jñānaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhāra varjitam mantra - pūjā - tapo - dhyānaṃ karmākarma tathaiva ca dharmaśāstrapurāṇāni etā vidyāścaturdaśa brahmajñānaṃ padaṃ jñātvā sarvavidyā sthirā bhavet yā punaḥ śāmbhavī vidyā guptā kulavadhūriva dehasthāḥ sarvatīrthāni guruvākyena labhyate dharma karma tathā japyametat sarvaṃ nivartate dehamadhye tathā devaḥ puṇyapāpavivarjitaḥ iḍāpiṅgalayormadhye suṣumnā ca sarasvatī tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate kīdṛśyadhyātmavidyā ca tanme brūhi maheśvara sā eva mudrā vicarantī khecarī sā eva vidyā vicarantī śāmbhavī darśanāni kathaṃ deva bhavanti ca pṛthak pṛthak prakṛtivādaratāḥ śāktā bauddhā śūnyātivādinaḥ sarvaṃ nāstīti cārvākā jalpanti viṣayāśritāḥ pañcabhūtaṃ kathaṃ deva guṇāḥ ke pañcaviṃśatiḥ pṛthvī pañcaguṇā proktā brahmajñānena bhāsate apāṃ pañcaguṇāḥ proktā brahmajñānena bhāsate tejaḥ pañcaguṇāḥ proktā brahmajñānena bhāsate vāyoḥ pañcaguṇāḥ proktā brahmajñānena bhāsate nabhaḥ pañcaguṇāḥ proktā brahmajñānena bhāsate raverutpadyate toyaṃ toyādutpadyate mahī

ravirvilīyate vāyau vāyurvilīyate tu khe pañcatattvāt paraṃ tattvaṃ tattvātītaṃ nirañjanam pañcendriyamidaṃ tattvaṃ manaḥ sādhakamindriyam sākārāśca vinaśyanti nirākāro na naśyati tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sākāraṃ tu parityajet ātmā caivāntarātmā ca paramātmā kathaṃ bhavet asti tvak caiva saptaite śarīreṣu vyavasthitāḥ paramātmā bhavecchūnyaṃ mano yatra vilīyate śūnyadhāturbhavet prāṇo garbhapiṇḍaṃ prajāyate vākyasya nirṇayaṃ brūhi paśya jñānamudāhara manasotpadyate vācā mano vācā vilīyate kasmin sthāne vased vāyuḥ kasmin sthāne vasenmanaḥ sūryāgre vasate vāyuścandrāgre vasate manaḥ etadyuktaṃ mahādevi guruvākyena labhyate kasmin sthāne vaset kālo jarā kena prajāyate antarikṣe vaset kālo jarā tena prajāyate jāgrat svapnasuṣuptau ca ko vā'sau pratibudhyati jāgratsvapnasuṣuptau ca vāyuśca pratibudhyati ko vā karoti pāpāni ko vā pāpaiḥ pramucyate manaśca tanmanā bhūtvā na puṇyairna ca pātakaiḥ kāryasya kāraṇaṃ brūhi kathaṃ kiñca prasādanam kāryaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ tvañca punarbodho viśiṣyate idaṃ tīrthamidaṃ tīrthaṃ bhramanti tāmasā janāḥ brahmavidyārato yastu sa vipro vedapāragaḥ sāraṃ tu yogibhiḥ pītaṃ takraṃ pibanti paṇḍitāḥ

nocchiṣṭaṃ brahmaṇo jñānamavyaktaṃ cetanāmayam ūrdhvaretā bhaved yastu sa devo na tu mānuṣaḥ tasya dhyānaprasādena saukhyaṃ mokṣaṃ na saṃśayaḥ brahmāgnau hūyate prāṇaṃ homakarma taducyate tasmāt sarvaprayatnena tādrūpyaṃ ca tyajed budhaḥ brahmajñānapadaṃ jñātvā sarvavarṇavivarjitaḥ niścayaṃ brūhi deveśa mano yatra vilīyate vinā svapnaṃ yathā nidrā brahmajñānaṃ taducyate bālabhāvastathā bhāvo brahmajñānaṃ taducyate sarvacintāparityāgo niścinto yoga ucyate śatajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati etanme brūhi bho deva paścājjñānaṃ prakāśaya ekaviṃśatibrahmāṇḍaṃ saptapātālameva ca madhyaśaktirbhavennābhiḥ śaktyatītaṃ nirañjanam cakrabhedaṃ mayākhyātaṃ cakrātītaṃ namo namaḥ ūrdhvamūlamadhaḥśākhaṃ vṛkṣākāraṃ kalevaram daśavāyuḥ kathaṃ deva daśadvārāṇi caiva hi samāno nābhideśe tu udānaḥ kaṇṭhamāśritaḥ nāga ūrdhvagato vāyuḥ kūrmastīrthāni saṃsthitaḥ dhanañjayo nādaghoṣe niviśeccaiva śāmyati navadvāraṃ ca prātyakṣaṃ daśamaṃ mana ucyate śaktiḥ kuṇḍalinī caiva prasūtā daśanāḍikā gāndhārī hastijihvā ca prasavā gamanāyatā kulaśca śaṅkhinī caiva vāmāṅge ca vyavasthitāḥ dvisaptatisahasrāṇi śarīre nāḍikāḥ smṛtāḥ

jñānanāḍī bhaveddevī yogināṃ siddhidāyinī trayo devā kathaṃ deva trayo bhāvāstrayo guṇāḥ krodhabhāvasthito rudrastrayo devāstrayo guṇāḥ nānābhāvaṃ mano yasya tasya muktirna jāyate manorūpaḥ sthito rudrastrayo devāstrayo guṇāḥ agnibhāvasthito rudrastrayo devāstrayo guṇāḥ nānābhāvaṃ mano yasya tasya muktirna jāyate ahaṃ rudro'pyahaṃ śūnyamahaṃ vyāpī nirañjanam svabhāvanirmalaṃ svāntaṃ sa evāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ satyavādī bhaved bhakto dātā dhīro hiterataḥ tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dayādharmaṃ samāśrayet vedasandhyā tapo dhyānaṃ homakarma kulaṃ katham brahmajñānasamaṃ puṇyaṃ kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm brahmajñānasamaṃ puṇyaṃ kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm na svāmī ca gurostulyaṃ yaddṛṣṭaṃ paramaṃ padam gurostulyaṃ na vai ko'pi yaddṛṣṭaṃ paramaṃ padam pṛthivyāṃ nāsti taddravyaṃ yaddattvā cānṛṇī bhavet yasya kasyāpi bhaktasya sadgurustasya dīyate saṃnyāsaṃ sarvakarmāṇi laukikāni tyajed budhaḥ tasmāt sarvaprayatnena yatiḥ saṅgaṃ parityajet makārastāmasaḥ proktastribhiḥ prakṛtirucyate īśvarānnirgatā sā hi prakṛtirguṇabandhanā avidyā mohinī yā sā śabdarūpā yaśasvinī makāraḥ sāmavedastu triṣu yukto'pyatharvaṇaḥ akārastvatha bhūrloka ukāro bhuva ucyate

akṣaraistribhiretaiśca bhavedātmā vyavasthitaḥ antarīkṣaṃ ukārastu vidyudvarṇa ihocyate dhruvamekākṣaraṃ brahma oṃ ityevaṃ vyavasthitam āsu sa jāyate yogī nānyathā śivabhāṣitam sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā śivalokaṃ sa gacchati paramārthaṃ ca nirvāṇaṃ sthūlasūkṣmasya lakṣaṇam sthūlarūpī sthito'yaṃ ca sūkṣmaśca anyathā sthitaḥ
